args.command:
python3 compress.py corpus.txt out.bin && python3 compress.py --decompress out.bin restored.txt && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import zlib
raw=Path('corpus.txt').read_bytes(); packed=Path('out.bin').read_bytes()
assert Path('restored.txt').read_bytes()==raw
baseline=len(zlib.compress(raw))
assert len(packed)<baseline
print('Byte-identical round trip:',len(raw),'->',len(packed),'bytes')
print('zlib default:',baseline,'bytes; saved',baseline-len(packed),'more bytes')
print('Percentage size reduction:',100*(1-len(packed)/len(raw)))

args.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
b=Path('corpus.txt').read_bytes(); rows=b.splitlines(keepends=True)
mid=[]; suffix=[]
for i,line in enumerate(rows):
 a,rest=line.rstrip(b'\n').split(b' ',1); text,c=rest.rsplit(b' ',1)
 assert a==f'{i:05d}'.encode(); mid.append(text); suffix.append(int(c))
assert all(s==i*7%89 for i,s in enumerate(suffix))
c=Counter(mid)
print('Rows:',len(rows),'unique middles',len(c),'final newline:',b.endswith(b'\n'))
print('Top messages:',c.most_common(12))
base={x for x,n in c.most_common(6)}; special=[(i,t) for i,t in enumerate(mid) if t not in base]
print('Exceptions:',len(special))
print('Exception vocabulary:',Counter(w for i,t in special for w in t.split()).most_common())
print('Exception lengths:',Counter(len(t.split()) for i,t in special))
print('Base by phase:',[Counter(mid[i::6]).most_common(1) for i in range(6)])
print('Gap counts:',Counter(b[0]-a[0] for a,b in zip(special,special[1:])).most_common(15))
print('last 3 lines',rows[-3:])
PY
